item.title: Theater League of Clifton Announces Auditions for “1776” — Tue Oct 27, 7:00 PM
item.description: The Theater League of Clifton will hold auditions for its upcoming production of “1776” on Tuesday, September 15; Wednesday, September 16; and Thursday, September 17, from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Callbacks by invitation may also be held Thursday, September 17. Auditions will be held at Living Hope, 303 Maplewood Ave., Clifton, NJ 07013. Performances will be held November 13, 14 and 15 at the Wayne Community Center, 1 Pike Drive, Wayne, NJ. The production will be directed by Maren Sugarman. With music and lyrics by Sherman Edwards and a book by Peter Stone, 1776 dramatizes the struggle within the Second Continental Congress to declare American independence. John Adams, Benjamin Franklin and Thomas Jefferson attempt to persuade a divided Congress to break with England while political, regional and personal conflicts threaten to derail the effort. item.title: Watchung Booksellers Hosts Ann Martin Ridings, "A Woven Woman" — Tue Oct 27, 7:00 PM — watchung booksellers the kids’ room
item.description:
Watchung Booksellers welcomes Ann Martin Ridings, author of the newly released memoir, A Woven Woman, on Tuesday, October 27 at 7:00 p.m. A Woven Woman is a lyrical, hybrid memoir composed in a distinct style— a stream of diary, poem, essay and observation—held together by emotional through-lines rather than chronology. In it, Ann uncovers motherhood, childhood, artistic identity, ancestral traces, and the hidden cartographies of a woman’s life. Tickets are $5 and include a 10% discount on the book purchased at the event. To register, visit watchungbooksellers.com. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

Mark your calendars: Tuesday, October 29, 1:30-3 pm at the mGAP Digital Lab, 60 S Fullerton Ave, Montclair. This hands-on workshop will provide a general introduction to shopping on Amazon.com. item.title: Awakening Awareness: Embracing This Moment (1 hour) — Tue Nov 3, 8:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream Feel free to join as we get still and practise presence within this moment. We will discuss and observe the obstacles that, seemingly, block us from being present and bring awareness to our unconsciousness in a safe, inclusive and affirming way.
Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teaching and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous.
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys has been passionate about mindfulness since 2010 and since 2021 he has been organising free, weekly online meditation groups. For more information on his free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group, visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/).
